text: Luca Iversen scored a smart goal for Kingsmoor FC in the 82nd minute to level the game at 3-3 against Westport Albion. After winning the ball with a strong tackle deep in their own half, he quickly passed forward to Mason Morales, who sent in a perfect cross for Iversen to finish from close range[#1512][#1514][#1516]. Kingsmoor’s quick and wide play helped them come back from behind late in the match, showing their skill at pressing and crossing.
